parameters.query:
SELECT a.*, u.unit_code, u.address, u.rent_amount, u.deposit_amount, u.lease_term_months
FROM applications a JOIN units u ON u.id = a.unit_id
WHERE a.ref_token = $1 AND a.envelope_id IS NULL
LIMIT 1;

parameters.claimsJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ iss: '__DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATION_KEY__', sub: '__DOCUSIGN_USER_ID__', aud: 'account-d.docusign.com', iat: Math.floor(Date.now()/1000), exp: Math.floor(Date.now()/1000) + 3600, scope: 'signature impersonation'}) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE applications SET
  envelope_id = $2,
  lease_status = 'sent',
  lease_sent_at = now(),
  status = 'lease_sent'
WHERE ref_token = $1 RETURNING *;

parameters.text:
=Lease sent for {{ $('Build Lease Document').first().json.ref_token }} - {{ $('Build Lease Document').first().json.full_name }}.

{{ $('Build Lease Document').first().json.unit_code }}, signature requested from {{ $('Build Lease Document').first().json.email }}.

parameters.query:
UPDATE applications SET
  lease_status = 'signed',
  lease_signed_at = now(),
  status = 'lease_signed'
WHERE envelope_id = $1
RETURNING *, (SELECT unit_code FROM units WHERE id = applications.unit_id) AS unit_code,
          (SELECT address FROM units WHERE id = applications.unit_id) AS address;
UPDATE units SET status = 'leased' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING *;
